checks.description: Default determinate/neutral/0 with Label and 0% publishes bounded zero without busy state.

tests.name: ProgressBar renders the default label, value text, and determinate accessibility state

checks.description: Missing/non-numeric/NaN resolves zero, below zero and above100 clamp, finite fractional values persist for determinate/static; supported root props/ref forward.
Three types/statuses and validation Icon slot plus owned native View props/ref compile without interactive/track replacement APIs.

Always label/header then track/indicator; trailing group only when resolved icon exists or value visible; icon before value, show flags/null/default/custom icons cover neutral/error/success without empty trailing container.
Label grows/shrinks/wraps while trailing group stays nonshrinking at opposite header edge with no invented header-track gap.
Explicit valueText (including empty) wins error Progress failed, success Complete, indeterminate Working…, then resolved percent in each type/status combination; showValueText gates visibility only.
Measured 200px track at 50 percent resolves 100px fill, while caller background wins and explicit value text renders.

tests.name: ProgressBar resolves the determinate indicator width from progress and preserves user styles last

checks.description: Before measurement fill zero; resizing recomputes percentage for 0/fractional/100 and indeterminate fixed segment/floor; determinate/static accept both increases and decreases and mode switches immediately.
Only measured indeterminate with reduced motion off runs 2000ms linear JS loop; zero track, static/determinate, reduced motion and unmount stop/reset offset; busy remains while static segment rests.
Actual native segment moves smoothly only when eligible, resets at leading edge and stays still with reduced motion; determinate/static width changes snap without transition.
Generated visible label ID is stable and appended to string/array caller labelledBy without mutation; root progressbar nonfocusable, every child decorative.
Determinate/static expose min0/max100/current; contextual text only when differing from plain percent; indeterminate busy with no range value even reduced-motion on.
No native Tab stop, focus visual, pointer/keyboard activation or outcome announcement is added; external cancel/retry remains separate.
UIA/AX announces task name and bounded/contextual value or indeterminate busy once, omits decorative validation and does not fabricate status live region.

Neutral/error/success share brand/danger/success indicator and 16px icon foreground; soft pill track at componentBase100 height, functional label/bodySmall value typography and gaps match tokens, root style final.
Review status colors/icons, thin track clipping, wrapping label/trailing alignment and scaled text across all renderers.

limitations: Anatomy table permits empty trailing group but PGB-002 and resolved divergence explicitly prohibit it; the requirement/resolved disposition governs.
Determinate transition uses ignored web-only keys and is not qualified as native animation.
Reduced-motion and animation mocks do not establish native movement or OS preference subscription; no screen-reader or pixel evidence is linked.
